message: Production report: our gpt-5.5 deployment sets the reasoning effort through litellm_params.extra_body ({reasoning_effort: low}). Since the latest main build, every POST /v1/chat/completions that includes a function tool comes back HTTP 400: "Function tools with reasoning_effort are not supported for gpt-5.5 in /v1/chat/completions". The same requests returned tool calls before the upgrade.
